name: Default
shortDescription: Lightweight LDAP server for user and group authentication with a web admin UI, backed by SQLite on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated LLDAP_LDAP_USER_PASS. It is only used to create the admin account on the first start; change the password later from the web UI. Never change LLDAP_KEY_SEED after the first start: LLDAP then refuses to start because stored passwords can no longer be verified.
Only the web UI is exposed. The LDAP port 3890 is reachable only from containers on the same private network, not from the internet.
